units.summary: Six document clerks manually enter freight-document information into the transport system.
units.quote: And then we have six document clerks, four in Vantaa, one in Tampere and one in Oulu, who type everything into our transport system by hand.

units.summary: Clerks manually enter document data into the TMS and enter invoicing-relevant fields into Business Central.
units.quote: Six document clerks (4 in Vantaa, 1 in Tampere, 1 in Oulu) key in the data manually into the TMS and, for invoicing-relevant fields, into Business Central.

source.locator: 3.1 Freight document processing (highest priority for the company)

units.summary: The advisors proposed testing a vision language model on real documents, including poor-quality photos and handwritten remarks, and comparing its field-level accuracy with clerk entries.
units.quote: And technically, we would test a vision language model on a sample of your real documents, including the bad photos and the handwritten remarks, and measure field level accuracy against what your clerks entered.

units.summary: The advisors identified handwriting as the main risk for document extraction and said it must be tested on real samples.
units.quote: Handwriting is the main risk; must be tested on real samples.

units.summary: The desired document workflow is for the system to read documents and fill TMS fields, with a person checking uncertain documents.
units.quote: Ideally, the system reads the document, finds the shipment, fills in the fields in the TMS, and a person only checks the uncertain ones.

units.summary: The proposed document system should flag damage remarks promptly so a claim can be made the same day.
units.quote: And it should flag the damage remarks immediately, so the claim can be made the same day.

units.summary: The proposed workflow extracts document fields into the TMS through its API, while a person checks uncertain results.
units.quote: Fields extracted → TMS via API, human checks only uncertain ones

units.summary: Staffing is currently planned weekly by shift supervisors using their experience and customer forecasts when available.
units.quote: Every week the shift supervisors plan the staffing for each warehouse. They use experience, last week's volumes, and the forecasts customers send by email, if they send them.

units.summary: The advisors described warehouse forecasting as classic time-series machine learning rather than generative AI.
units.quote: It's classic time series machine learning, not really generative AI.

units.summary: The proposed first step for forecasting is to assess the WMS data; the work could become a thesis topic.
units.quote: Second, for forecasting, the first step is a data assessment.

units.summary: The proposed AI workflow would classify incoming emails, route them, retrieve shipment status from the TMS, and draft replies for agents.
units.quote: So the idea would be to classify incoming emails, route them, look up the shipment status from the TMS, and draft a reply for the agent?

units.summary: Customer service replies are not intended to be fully automatic; an agent should approve each answer at least initially.
units.quote: But not fully automatic replies. The agent should approve every answer, at least in the beginning.

units.summary: The advisors considered freight document processing the best candidate for the first proof of concept.
units.quote: First, we think the freight document processing is the best candidate for a first proof of concept.

units.summary: Route optimisation was raised because planners override the TMS when it lacks customers' actual unloading times; a vendor update might be available in 2027.
units.quote: Route optimization, because our TMS planning doesn't know the customer's real unloading times, so the planners override it. But the TMS vendor might have an update in 2027.

units.summary: Predictive maintenance for trucks was mentioned, and telematics data is available.
units.quote: Predictive maintenance for the trucks, we have telematics data, but our fleet manager wasn't able to join today.

units.summary: Automatic customs declarations were mentioned as an idea, but Kaisa considered them too risky for now.
units.quote: And Kaisa has mentioned automatic customs declarations, but she thinks that's too risky for now.
